summary: DimensionCompiler translates each Dimension's MatchStrategy into a backend-agnostic ternary BaseExpressionAPI expression template — one _compile_<strategy> method per strategy.
extension_points: Adding a MatchStrategy implements a new _compile_<strategy> method here (CLAUDE.md recipe).
lifecycle_notes: EXACT_KEY strategy added (_compile_exact_key: rule-side-wildcard-only exact match for partition routing).
REGEX (per-row pattern column) split from CONTEXT_REGEX (metadata literal pattern).
Bool-dimension ternary comparisons added (_compile_bool_ternary: null on either side is don't-care).
risks: _compile_regex_per_row carries a '# allow:' backend-purity exemption (Polars-native fallback pending upstream regex_contains column-pattern support in mountainash) — documented in CLAUDE.md.
